reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount and reuses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold tolerance helper from shared/rules instead of re-deriving the 7.5% rule; the API field also calls the same helper.

duplication.why: Removes the inline midpoint copy in schedule-template.ts by routing it through getScheduledAmount, and adds no new copy of the rule.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the tree keeps it and the API field is added in the api handler; threading the op through display-only UI call sites (SchedulesTable cell, list filters, edit reducer) makes them show the planning value rather than the entered one, a slightly blurred concern.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and the API field; the call-site edits are mechanical, though touching the edit-form reducer and display filters goes a bit beyond what planning needs.

maintainability.why: One helper with an op parameter decides every case and is well tested; the positional amountOp inserted before inverse and the redundant Math.round are minor wrinkles.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All schedule-amount call sites, including the previously divergent schedule-template.ts, go through getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The schedule-template midpoint copy is removed, not reshaped; the approx tolerance reuses getApproxNumberThreshold.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount (shared/schedules.ts) gains an amountOp parameter and an isapprox branch, which are the real variation the steps ask for; no call site bypasses it.
